placeMentions.snippet: Better Together Hubs set in Le Forest hotel and resort; hub runs for 3-week sessions between October and April for families with kids aged 3–13.
Located in the mountains in rural Spain, this place is very much a community driven worldschool hub — continuous open community with family apartments, no fixed start/end dates.
Culture Chalk hub in San Juan, Lake Atitlan; 11-day sessions with cultural immersion, Spanish lessons, and host family pairing program.
Bliss Hubs: free and flexible community-driven hub with members suggesting activities to join; WhatsApp-coordinated weekly activities.
During the months November–April there is a huge worldschooling community on Koh Lanta.
